entries.267ef4ac2cba6422: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells quartz crystal products, such as quartz crystal resonators and quartz crystal oscillators. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,784 million. The company is mainly responsible for research and development and sales. Manufacturing is mainly handled by Aomori River Techno Co., Ltd. and Xi'an Dahe Crystal Oscillator Technology Co., Ltd., and sales are handled by the company, Taiwan Liba Co., Ltd., River Electronics (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. and Xi'an Dahe Crystal Oscillator Technology Co., Ltd., in an integrated structure spanning research and development, manufacturing and sales.
entries.4156824e5ca6b7c7: An electronic component that integrates a quartz crystal resonator and an oscillator circuit (IC) into a single unit. For next-generation infrastructure markets such as data centers, the company has developed the 'KCRO-05' quartz crystal oscillator, which operates at high frequencies with extremely low phase jitter, and is advancing sample shipments and the establishment of a mass production system. Revenue by product category is not disclosed.
entries.47c93b4f81710401: An electronic components manufacturer that develops, manufactures and sells crystal products such as crystal units and crystal oscillators.
entries.fd90b76c3f441d36: An electronic component that uses the stable frequency-generating properties of quartz, maintaining stable radio frequencies and generating reference signals that keep electronic circuits operating at the right timing, as well as the reference signals that keep time in clocks. Tuning-fork quartz crystal resonators for smartphones and other devices are the main products. Revenue by product category is not disclosed.
